title: Identifying Reprogramming Factor Expression via Single-Nuclei Multiome Sequencing
author: Fei, Zhang, et al.
materials: One Shot Stbl3 chemically competent E. coli
SYBR Green I nucleic acid gel stain

steps.title: Isolate nuclei from reprogramming cells
steps.instruction: Collect reprogramming cells at the desired time points, isolate nuclei using 10× Genomics protocol CG000365, remove dead cells if viability is below 90% with the 10× protocol, count nuclei per condition and pool the required number (e.g., 800 nuclei per TF for Grade A or ≥1,000 for Grade B) ensuring balanced representation; do not pool cells before nuclei isolation.

steps.title: Prepare ATAC and GEX libraries
steps.instruction: Generate ATAC and gene‑expression (GEX) libraries following the 10× Genomics user guide CG000338.

steps.title: First PCR for barcode library
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL PCR on ice: 3 µL pre‑amplified sample, 25 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, 2.5 µL 10 µM Truseq_Read2_Vec_Amp_Forward Primer, 2.5 µL 10 µM Truseq_Read1_Amp_Reverse Primer, add nuclease‑free water to 50 µL. Mix, brief centrifuge, then PCR: 95 °C 3 min; 98 °C 20 s; 22 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 65 °C 15 s, 72 °C 10 s; final extension 72 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C. (Optional: add SYBR Green I and run qPCR to determine optimal cycle number at 1/3 max R.C.). Clean up with 0.8× SPRIselect beads: vortex beads, add 40 µL beads, mix 10×, incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C, magnet high, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), magnet low, remove ethanol, add 40.5 µL Buffer EB, mix 10×, incubate 2 min at 20‑25 °C, brief spin, magnet low, transfer 40 µL to a new tube. Store at –20 °C or continue.

steps.title: Second PCR with indexing
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL indexing PCR on ice: 50 ng template DNA from the first‑PCR cleanup, 25 µL 2× KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, 10 µL Dual Index TT Set A, add nuclease‑free water to 50 µL (use distinct indices for multiplexed runs). PCR: 95 °C 3 min; 98 °C 20 s; 4 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 65 °C 15 s, 72 °C 10 s; final extension 72 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C. (Optional: SYBR Green I qPCR as above.) Clean up with 0.8× SPRIselect beads: vortex, add 40 µL beads, mix 10×, incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C, magnet high, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s), magnet low, remove ethanol, add 30.5 µL Buffer EB, mix, incubate 2 min at 20‑25 °C, brief spin, magnet low, transfer 30 µL to a new tube. Store at –20 °C or proceed.

steps.title: Library quality control
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL of each ATAC, GEX, and barcode library 1:5 and run on an Agilent TapeStation High Sensitivity D5000 ScreenTape to obtain average fragment size. Quantify each library with the KAPA Library Quantification Kit using the fragment‑size information from the TapeStation.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence ATAC and GEX libraries according to 10× Genomics user guide CG000338. Sequence the barcode library with the same parameters as the GEX library, targeting a minimum of 2,000 read pairs per nucleus. (Optional: verify fragment size with a Bioanalyzer or LabChip.)

steps.title: Process and analyze sequencing data
steps.instruction: Extract TF barcodes from the barcode FASTQ files using BioPython SeqIO. Process GEX and ATAC FASTQ files with Cell Ranger ARC v2.0.1 for demultiplexing, alignment, and feature counting. Load results into Seurat v4.1.1 and Signac v1.7.0, adding TF‑barcode read counts as a metadata column. Filter out cells with >100,000 RNA UMI counts, >500,000 ATAC fragments, or >30 % mitochondrial RNA. Normalize scRNA‑seq data with SCTransform while regressing out cell‑cycle and mitochondrial effects; select the top 3,000 variable genes and run PCA (use PCs 1‑35). Call scATAC peaks with MACS2 v2.2.7.1, remove peaks on nonstandard chromosomes and GRCh38 blacklist regions, then perform TF‑IDF normalization and LSI (use dimensions 2‑35). Build a weighted‑nearest‑neighbor graph using RNA PCs 1‑35 and ATAC LSI 2‑35. Compute per‑cell motif activity scores with Signac RunChromVAR. Assign cell‑type scores with ScType v1.0 using pancreatic and fibroblast marker sets.
